scripts.build: rm -rf dist/ && mkdir dist/ && cp appsscript.json public/; pnpm --filter sidebar --filter template-page --filter dialog run --parallel build && mv dialog/dist/index.html dist/dialog.html && mv sidebar/dist/index.html dist/sidebar.html && mv template-page/dist/index.html dist/template-page.html && for f in $(ls -a public/ | tail -n +3); do cp public/$f dist/; done; pnpm -w run build:server && mv server/Code.js dist/Code.gs
scripts.build:dev: rm -rf dist/ && mkdir dist/ && cp appsscript.json public/; pnpm --filter sidebar --filter template-page --filter dialog run --parallel build --mode development && mv dialog/dist/index.html dist/dialog.html && mv sidebar/dist/index.html dist/sidebar.html && mv template-page/dist/index.html dist/template-page.html && for f in $(ls -a public/ | tail -n +3); do cp public/$f dist/; done; pnpm -w run build:server && mv server/Code.js dist/Code.gs
scripts.build:watch:
# TODO: Fix this
nodemon --exec 'pnpm run build'
scripts.clasp:create: pnpm build && cd dist && clasp create --title Flowcast --type docs && cp appsscript.json .. && cp .clasp.json ../public
scripts.clasp:push: pnpm -w --filter sidebar --filter template-page --filter dialog run --parallel typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm run clasp:prebuilt
